verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a design platform, but the evidence pack never documents a telemetry or usage-tracking setting or opt-out control. The only related material is adjacent: self-hosting in your own environment and a general privacy pledge ('Penpot will never make business out of your data'). Neither is an opt-out mechanism, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
